conviction_note: Two small negatives (a Q2 already visible in the public 月次, and a same-group peer's forecast cut that raises the odds of a cut here) on a name whose post-release next-day moves have run 0.1-1.4% for three years; abs_move 1.3 near the 1.44 proxy, p_up 47 because the 月次 miss is public and this company held a plan it was missing at last year's H1 (stock +0.45 next day), giving (2*0.47-1)*1.3 = -0.08 against an impact_sum of -0.55; the gap is the held-plan relief case that the per-finding sizes do not carry.
bar: No H1 company guide, no IFIS/四季報 number reachable, Yahoo JP shows no consensus. Bars used: full-year company plan OP 8,700m / OI 8,200m held at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260703587734.pdf) and prior-year H1 OP 2,463m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251014/140120251009571162.pdf). print_vs_bar is my estimate of H1 OP vs prior-year H1 (~2.2-2.3bn vs 2,463m). The street bar is unsourced, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from baseline). 信用倍率 0.60 (kabutan quote page, 2026-10-13: margin shorts exceed margin longs), so there is no crowded leveraged long left to sell a visible miss; if anything the setup squeezes mildly. No options, no skew. Run-up 20d -1.52%, 5d -0.24%; the price did not move on USMH's 10-09 cut (841 on 10-09 and at 10:12 on 10-13).

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug 2026) existing-store sales slowed to 99.8 / 101.0 / 102.5 (about +1.1%) from Q1's +2.7%. Total-company sales 99.4 / 100.6 / 102.1, and clothing, the high-margin line, ran 87.7 / 95.0 / 98.3. Q1 OP was already -6.3% on weak clothing and a gross margin held down by competition, so H1 OP likely lands below last year's 2,463m. Progress on the 8,700m plan would then be about 25-27%, close to last year's 25.1% at H1 (2,463 of 9,800), a plan the company held and then missed by 15%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-14 H1 with OP -20% and the plan held: 886 -> 890 next day (+0.45%). 2026-07-10 Q1 with OP -6.3%: -0.24% next day. 2024-10-09 H1 with a downward revision: -0.45% next day (Yahoo daily closes, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/7512.T?range=3y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 月次 are public and the stock has drifted from 853 before Q1 to 841. What remains unpriced is the gross margin, which the 月次 do not show. The stock trades flat with the short register at zero and margin shorts above margin longs, so a visible miss has no crowded long left to sell into.
findings.independence: The Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260703587734.pdf) gives the same mechanism: clothing missed plan and the gross margin did not rise because of competition. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-09, United Super Markets HD (3222), an Aeon-group food supermarket peer, cut its FY2027/2 OP forecast from 100億 to 10億 at its H1 print. It cited a gross margin below plan from price responses under inflation and competition, the same pressure Aeon Hokkaido named in its Q1 (and Aeon's TopValu price freeze ran through August). That raises the odds that Aeon Hokkaido trims its 8,700m plan at this print rather than holding it as it did last year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Its one recent mid-year cut (2024-10-09, H1, 15:00) moved -0.34% on the day and -0.45% the next day. It held at H1 in 2025 despite a -20% H1 (+0.45% next day). The new-year guide at the FY print (2026-04-09, 13:30, NI guided -19.6%) was the largest move in three years: -3.42% on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: 7512 closed 840 on 10-08, 841 on 10-09 and 841 on 10-13: no reaction to the peer's cut, while USMH fell to a year-to-date low. If the market had read USMH across to Aeon's Hokkaido subsidiary, 7512 would show a step down on 10-13. Coverage is near zero (no consensus on Yahoo JP), so nobody publishes a bar for the cut to land against. This is transmission from a peer, not a company document, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The Aeon Hokkaido Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260710/140120260703587734.pdf) names competition holding the gross margin back. It is a different source, but it supports the mechanism, not the decision to revise.

outside_window.finding: If the plan is held at H1, the year-end miss risk shown by last year's pattern (held at H1, missed by 15.5% at FY) carries into the Q3 print in January or the FY print in April 2027.

baseline_tension: Both findings lean slightly negative. Positioning carries the opposite lean: margin ratio 0.6, zero disclosed shorts, priced_lean +0.19. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held plan with a gross-margin explanation, which is what happened at last year's H1 (+0.45% next day) and is the base case for a company that held last year. I looked for a buyback or dividend change and found no precedent or signal. This is close to an honest zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 / computable 進捗率): the 月次 finding was cut from -0.3 to -0.15, and p_up moved from 45 to 47.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive (held plan, as in 2025) into baseline_tension. I had already looked for returns, so this did not move p_up again.
The USMH / forecast-revision finding was left at -0.4: it is about what the release could ADD (a cut), which rule 1 exempts.
